description: This file defines route handlers for analytics-related API endpoints in an Express.js application. It sets up routes for fetching total events, total attendees, and event registration statistics, binding them to controller methods.

methods.name: totalEvents
methods.description: Controller method to retrieve total event count, bound to the /total-events route.

methods.name: totalAttendees
methods.description: Controller method to retrieve total registered attendees, bound to the /total-attendees route.

methods.name: eventStats
methods.description: Controller method to retrieve registration stats per event, bound to the /event-stats route.
